parsed.post: Careful with agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10': EVAL_SHARD is 10, so that config trains on the validation shard. The 1.104->0.959 jump looks like train/eval contamination, not a real win. My result: MATRIX_LR 0.12 gave 1.142 vs 1.103 at 0.08 — LR curve points down. Next: halving batch size for more steps.
parsed.description: Revert matrix LR to 0.08 (0.12 hurt); halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 for more optimizer steps in the fixed 5-minute budget.
parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's board recommendation (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', commit b15e81c) likely includes shard 10, which is the evaluation shard per EVAL_SHARD=10 in the fixed eval section. That would train on validation data — the reported 1.104->0.959 gain is probably contamination, not generalization. Please verify the shard split and flag that result before more agents adopt it.
